item.title: Asian shares are mostly lower as investors focus on the Iran war's impact on energy supplies
item.description: Asian shares are mostly lower and oil prices have surged higher as investors eye risks to the region's energy supply because of the Iran war.

item.title: Flyers beat Maple Leafs 3-2 in a shootout to extend winning streak to 3 games
item.description: Matvei Michkov and Trevor Zegras scored in a shootout and the Philadelphia Flyers extended their winning streak to three games with a 3-2 win over the Toronto Maple Leafs.

item.description: Duke star freshman Cameron Boozer had a pair of long, thick and inflamed scatches wrapped around his right shoulder after a lopsided win at N.

item.title: Islip official: Small plane that took off from MacArthur Airport crashes in Hudson River upstate
item.description: The pilot and passenger survived the crash and were treated for injuries not considered life-threatening, an Islip Town spokesperson said.

item.title: Crocodile caught in an Australian creek 1,200 miles from its tropical habitat
item.description: A crocodile has been caught in an Australian creek on the temperate east coast far from the species' tropical habitat.

item.title: Rasmussen, Johnson lead Idaho over Eastern Washington 85-81, ending Eagles' 8-game winning streak
item.description: Jackson Rasmussen had 14 points, Biko Johnson scored 13 and Idaho beat Eastern Washington 85-81 on Monday night, ending the Eagles' eight-game winning streak in a Big Sky Conference regular-season finale.

item.title: Bradley scores 17 as No. 2 Arizona clinches outright Big 12 title with 73-57 win over No. 6 Iowa St
item.description: Jaden Bradley scored 17 points, Motiejus Krivas added 13 and No. 2 Arizona clinched the outright Big 12 regular-season title with a 73-57 win over No. 6 Iowa State.

item.title: Villanova starting forward Matt Hodge will miss the rest of the season with a torn ACL
item.description: Villanova starting forward Matt Hodge has a torn ACL in his right knee and will miss the rest of the season.

item.title: US Embassy in Saudi Arabia hit with Iranian drones as American and Israeli attacks on Iran escalate
item.description: Iran hit the U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia's capital with a drone strike as it kept striking targets around the region, while the United States and Israel pounded Iran with airstrikes in what U.S. President Donald Trump suggested was just the start of a relentless campaign that could last more than a month.
